subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Travel Rule for Crypto
description: A quick, practical guide to The Travel Rule for Crypto.

hook.text: When you wire money through a bank, your identity travels with it. Crypto transfers carried no such info until now.

buildup.text: The Travel Rule requires crypto exchanges to share sender and receiver identity data for large transfers.

discovery.text: FATF extended the banking Travel Rule to crypto in 2019. Implementation has been slow and uneven.

twist.text: Many exchanges lack the technical infrastructure to share identity data securely with each other.

climax.text: The Travel Rule is simple in concept but enormously complex in a decentralized, borderless ecosystem.

punchline.text: Send your identity with your crypto. Simple idea. Hard to build.

quiz.question: What does the Travel Rule require for crypto?
options: Exchanges must share sender and receiver identity data
Users must physically travel to make transactions
